description: Use this when the user asks AutoIsto to keep watching Czech car listings for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about an estate car under 300 000 CZK, not diesel"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or other personal data: it returns a consentUrl on www.autoisto.cz that the user must open themselves, enter their own e-mail there and confirm by clicking the link AutoIsto e-mails them. Never ask the user for their e-mail in the conversation and never open the link for them. An unconfirmed draft is deleted after 24 hours. Matching cars are e-mailed to the user and can also be read with intent_list_matches using the returned intentCode — keep it in the conversation. hiddenLimitCzk is optional: the most the user would pay, stored encrypted and never shown to sellers or returned by any tool; pass it only if the user said it. Matches come from listings AutoIsto CZ aggregates from the Czech market (its own sellers' listings and public listings from Czech car portals), so they cover only cars listed on AutoIsto CZ (Czech Republic, CZK) and may be incomplete.

buyBy.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the user wants to buy; watching stops after it.

hiddenLimitCzk.description: Optional private maximum price in CZK; encrypted on receipt and never returned by any tool.

niceToHave.description: Wishes that are not required (never filters), e.g. "tažné, automat".

statement.description: What the car MUST be, as one short Czech (or Slovak) phrase with prices in CZK, e.g. "kombi do 300000 Kč ne diesel".

name: intent_publish_intent

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO time after which the unconfirmed draft is deleted.

consentUrl.description: Page on www.autoisto.cz where the USER confirms the intent with their own e-mail. Show it unchanged.

hasHiddenLimit.description: Whether a hidden limit was stored. Its value is never returned.

intentCode.description: Secret code of this intent; use it with intent_get_intent, intent_list_matches and intent_withdraw_intent.

notUnderstood.description: Words of the statement that are NOT watched for. Tell the person.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the AutoIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = AutoIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

understood.description: What AutoIsto will watch for, read from the statement (in Czech). Tell the person before they confirm.

title: Watch new car listings for the user (needs the user's confirmation)
